name: Novotel Convention & Spa Antananarivo
desc: The Novotel Madagascar offers a 5-star experience with world-class comfort. 180 rooms include luxurious hi-tech suites and offer panoramic views of Antananarivo. An events space can easily be adapted for up to 800 people, and there are several choices of restaurants and bars, a spa, indoor pool and fitness area. Novotel Convention & Spa is the go-to spot for lifestyle amenities in Antananarivo.

name: ibis Antananarivo Ankorondrano
desc: Located in the business district, the ibis Antananarivo hotel offers 174 modern bedrooms, each with their own desk, A/C and free, unlimited high-speed WiFi. To make your stay more enjoyable, our hotel offers a fitness room, spa with sauna, hammam and outdoor swimming pool. You can relax in the bar open 24/7. Enjoy our restaurant that extends over the sunny garden with local and international delights.

name: Mantis Soanambo Hotel And Spa
desc: Escape to Soanambo Hotel & Spa, an idyllic boutique retreat on Sainte Marie Island, off Madagascar's east coast. Nestled in a lush tropical garden with breathtaking Indian Ocean views and 48 beautifully appointed spacious Superior Rooms with modern amenities. Explore the island's natural beauty and rich culture with whale watching, snorkelling, island tours and local village visits. Experience ultimate relaxation…
